title: One task in both designs, run in the walkthrough.
caption: The task: {{fact:wt-task}}. Both designs run in one soroban-sim session per design ({{fact:wt-host}}): the OpenZeppelin {{fact:oz-v080-tag}} account {{fact:wt-oz-account-build}}, oz-policy-builder's interpreter {{fact:opb-interpreter-wasm-short}} and OpenZeppelin's `spending_limit` {{fact:wt-oz-spending-limit-build}}, with the rule policy-synth synthesises; and Perch {{fact:perch-pin-short}} with one grant. Instruction counts come from the recording-mode host, not exact metering, and measure two different contract stacks; they are not a performance result. Every refusal is an enforcing simulation that left the ledger unchanged.
